summary: Phase 1 testing complete. Backend: 12/12 new pytest cases pass (photos POST/DELETE, signature, files auth, cross-tenant 403, public company w/o owner_id, public booking creates unscheduled+source=booking_widget, PATCH scheduled_at promotes unscheduled→scheduled). Frontend: Schedule page renders with unscheduled sidebar, JobDetail (/app/jobs/:id) shows notes/photos grid/signature canvas + Start Job, Settings shows shareable booking link with Copy button, public /book/{companyId} renders form and successfully submits (success state shown). Native HTML5 date input is used for Preferred date/time on booking form (browser default picker — design note).

issues: Uses native browser date/time picker (input type=datetime-local) instead of shadcn Calendar — consider for branded UX

critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~800 lines — exceeds 700 threshold; recommend splitting into routers/{auth,jobs,files,public,payments}.py
init_storage() is called synchronously inside async endpoints via requests — consider httpx/async to avoid blocking event loop on first request
GET /api/files/{path} accepts token via ?auth= query — fine for , but logs may capture tokens; consider short-lived signed URLs
File path validation correctly enforces APP_NAME/{company_id}/ prefix — multi-tenant isolation verified
seed_data_creation: Tests create+cleanup TEST_ prefixed jobs/customers; public booking creates jobs with source=booking_widget
